name: Sefina Rousseau
title: The Painter
ability: Forced - When you would draw your opening hand: Draw 13 cards, instead. Choose up to 5 events to place beneath this card and keep 8 cards as your opening hand. Discard the rest. (You cannot mulligan.) [action]: Choose an event beneath this card and draw it. Does not provoke attacks of opportunity. [elder_sign] effect: +3. You may choose an event beneath this card and draw it.
ability_cn: 强制 - 在你将要抽取起始手牌时：改为抽取13张卡牌。选择最多5张事件卡放在本卡牌下，并保留8张卡牌作为你的起始手牌。丢弃其余卡牌。(你不能换牌。) [action]：选择并抽取本卡牌下方的一张事件卡。不会引起趁乱攻击。 [elder_sign]效果：+3。你可以选择并抽取本卡牌下的一张事件卡。
elder_sign: [elder_sign] effect: +3. You may choose an event beneath this card and draw it.
elder_sign_cn: [elder_sign]效果：+3。你可以选择并抽取本卡牌下的一张事件卡。
back_text: Deck Size: 33. Deckbuilding Options: Rogue cards ([rogue]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, Mystic cards ([mystic]) level 0-2. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): 3 copies of The Painted World, 1 copy of Stars of Hyades, 1 random basic weakness.
back_text_cn: 卡牌张数：33。 牌组构建选项：流浪者卡([rogue])等级0-5，中立卡牌等级0-5，潜修者卡([mystic])等级0-2。 牌组构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：3张画中世界、毕宿星团、1张随机基础弱点。
